cohort: All pregnant women with a gestational age of more than 28 weeks who delivered at Narendra Modi Medical College and Hospital during the study period.
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 49.63%, with Robson Group 5 (women with previous CS) having the highest CS rate (20.38%) and being the most significant contributor to the overall high CS rate.
mod_finding: Women with previous caesarean section (Robson group 5) constitute the most important determinant of overall caesarean section rates.
